Name: Hot Spring behind Joja Mart Redux
Author: Kreeate777
Description:
This is an update of the "[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/357]Hot Spring behind Joja Market[/url]" mod by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/2642839]DevilBro[/url]
Works with SDV 1.5+


Note: If using this mod on an existing save, you may need to remove some bushes at the stairs to the Hot Spring.
This can be done by using the "[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6304]Destroyable Bushes[/url]" mod.
All new maps will have the obstructing bushes removed automatically.


[size=3][b][u]Compatibility[/u][/b][/size]
*This mod is [b]not[/b] compatible with the following mods:

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7313]
[/url][s][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7313]Wilford - New Custom NPC[/url]﻿[/s]  -  Support for this mod has been added with update 1.0.1

﻿*Potentially any other mod that changes the default Town map in the area behind Joja Mart.
